title: 1. Themes: Turning Visual Direction into a Reusable System
use_cases: Implement when translating brand guidelines into a functional form system
Configure when adjusting UI density for different user types like power-users
Use when establishing a visual hierarchy through typography and emphasis
Configure when wanting to align form aesthetics with a specific product story or mood
content:
Your theme is the quickest way to make a form feel like it belongs to your new brand—even if the rest of your site hasn’t caught up yet.

Think beyond “make it pretty.” A strong theme encodes your product story into:

- Color choices (calm vs energetic, playful vs serious)
- Typography (friendly vs technical, large vs compact)
- Density and spacing (airy and focused vs data-dense and power-user oriented)
- Emphasis (what gets color, what stays neutral, where the eye is drawn)
